text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hm? There's something awfully<n>different about
you today. Did you<n>become... more grown-up?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, you think so? I didn't notice it<n>myself...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ah, I got it. It must be your birthday,<n>right?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Um, yes! That's amazing. You<n>could tell that
just by looking?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
A little. It also looks like you've got a<n>huuuge
craving for some cake at the<n>cafe near the station!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wow, you're right! Incredible, I only<n>told that to
Bourbon—no one else!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Haha, just my intuition is all. Since<n>we're both out,
shall we go together?<n>It's your birthday, so my
treat.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Thanks so much! Hehe, this is<n>great. I can buy
some for Bourbon<n>too!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Good idea. But don't worry, that'll be<n>on me too.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...To pay her back for the intel.
